documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our construction services team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's construction services team is exploring options but has not identified a specific requirement or project owner. This lack of clarity is creating operational friction, as they are unable to proceed with arranging a discovery meeting without further clarification.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your construction services team is currently exploring options, but there is still some uncertainty about the specific requirements or who will be leading the project. To ensure we provide the most relevant support, could you clarify what specific needs or goals you're looking to address? This will help us prepare for a discovery meeting that aligns with your priorities.
questions: What specific needs or goals are you looking to address with Cedar Systems?
Who within your team will be responsible for leading this project or making decisions?
uncertainties: The lack of identified requirements or project owner creates uncertainty about the scope and direction of the engagement.
